title: 第七章 新仇旧恨第八章 贵客上门
lines: 第七章:新仇旧恨
听叶重说完事情的始末，沈浩顿了顿，沉声道：“重儿，你做的很好。只是此事就像你所说的，没那么简单。你和玥儿能够全身而退，也多亏了重儿当机立断，否则后果不堪设想！”。
沈浩微笑着看了一眼面目沉重，并不因为自己的赞扬而面露喜色的叶重。随即转过头盯着沈玥冷声道：“玥儿，今天的事，由你而起，在事情没有结束之前，不得出堡一步，给我好好反省一番，改改你的性子。否则还不知道，你以后还会惹出什么祸事！”。
“知道了，爷爷。”，沈玥语气低落的答道。
沈玥知道，因为自己的因素，给天鹰堡带了多大的危机。甚至此次如果不是叶重，只怕自己，已经被皇甫炎那个畜牲给糟蹋了。
看着神情低落的沈玥，沈彤摇了摇头，语重心长的对沈玥道：“玥儿，你有绝佳的修炼天赋，可是却一直不努力修炼。如果你是武王强者，像皇甫炎这等纨绔子弟敢对你意图不轨，那铁卫军敢来捉拿你？甚至如果你是武皇、武尊强者，现在慌慌不可终日的，就不是我天鹰堡，而是他药皇殿才对！”。
品了一口参茶，沈彤接着说道：“重儿，玥儿！你们要记住，这个世界是一个武力的世界，是强者的世界，拳头大的说了算！”。
紧紧的握了握秀拳，沈玥感激的对沈彤轻声道：“谢谢姑姑，玥儿知道了！”。
一旁的沈泰也是插嘴道：“玥儿，你姑姑说的没错。记得好好修炼，争取早日突破五级武者，做到元气外放，通过天渊府的考核。有天渊府学员的身份保障，量他药皇殿也不敢打你的主意。”。
顿了顿，沈泰看了看叶重，随即却是面带愧疚之色的沉声道：“只是重儿就····”。
闻言，沈彤却是打断了沈泰，沉声道：“我沈彤的儿子，也不是谁想动就能动的！而且那药皇殿与我天鹰堡的恩怨，也不是能说化解就能化解的，此次不过是新仇加旧恨罢了！别人怕他药皇殿，我沈彤可不怕！”。
沈泰搓了搓手，讪讪的干笑道：“妹妹，我不是这个意思！”。
接着却是转过头，面露喜色的对叶重轻声嘱咐道：“那个明天有贵客来，重儿好好准备，不要出了什么差错，恶了贵客！这可是重儿你的转机，可得好好珍惜。”。
沈玥却是惊奇的轻声询问道：“贵客？谁啊！”。
拍了一下沈玥的脑袋，沈泰笑骂道：“你这个死丫头，还嫌你惹的祸不够大啊！没你的事，别瞎打听，明天就知道了！”。
摆了摆手，沈浩笑着对叶重和沈玥道：“重儿、玥儿，你们都回去歇息吧！把心放到肚子去，药皇殿对我天鹰堡来说，虽然是不可撼动的庞然大物，但我天鹰堡也不是任人欺辱的小蚂蚱。想动我天鹰堡，他药皇殿也要掂量掂量。”。
接着也是对叶重嘱咐道：“重儿，明天好好表现！我和你母亲、舅舅还有事情要谈，你们先房休息吧！”。
“好的，外公！”
“是的，爷爷！”
看着离开的叶重和沈玥，沈浩却是眼神严肃，脸色沉重的沉声道：“彤儿，泰儿！这药皇殿之事，恐怕是城主府的阴谋。他尹克西，端是设了好一个借刀杀人的圈套！”。
点了点头，沈彤冷声道：“那要看他尹克西借的刀，快不快了。别人没杀到，反而伤了自己。如果不是忌惮郡守府，他尹家早就成为历史了！”。
惊讶的看了一眼自己的妹妹，沈泰随即沉声道：“十五年前，妹夫帮助药王谷，定下了那二十年之约，而恶了药皇殿。此次恐怕药皇殿，要借这件事的缘由，对付我天鹰堡啊！”。
顿了顿，沈泰随后却是面露希翼之色的期盼道：“这件事，估计药王谷已经收到风声了。而药王谷的实力，并不弱那药皇殿多少。尤其在这天龙郡，如果药王谷念旧情，死保我天鹰堡和重儿，那我们也就不用如此担忧了！”。
沈浩摇了摇头，却是担忧的说道：“泰儿，你太乐观了。那药曦乃百年难得一遇的修行天才，被药王谷视为其崛起的希望！并且长得也是俏丽可人，美名远播。听说上门求亲的豪门俊杰，更是多不胜数！”。
看了一眼脸色冰冷的沈彤，沈浩接着说道：“重儿至今都没有形成‘元轮’，成为‘武者’。只怕药曦那等天之骄女，看不上重儿。而且药王谷估计也不愿意，要重儿这个连武者都不是的废人，做他药王谷的佳婿。”。

Chapter 7: New and old grudges
After hearing Ye Zhong tell the whole story, Shen Hao paused and said in a deep voice: "Zhong'er, you did a good job. But this matter is just like you said, it's not that simple. You and Yue'er were able to escape unscathed, thanks to Zhong'er's quick decision, otherwise the consequences would be disastrous!"
Shen Hao smiled and glanced at Ye Chong, who had a heavy face and was not happy because of his praise. Then he turned his head and stared at Shen Yue and said coldly: "Yue'er, what happened today started with you. Before the matter is over, don't leave the fort. Let me reflect on it and change your temper. Otherwise, I don't know what trouble you will cause in the future!".
"I know, Grandpa." Shen Yue replied in a low tone.
Shen Yue knew how much crisis he had brought to Tianying Castle because of his own factors. Even if it weren't for Ye Zhong this time, I'm afraid that he would have been ruined by that beast Huangfu Yan.
Looking at the depressed Shen Yue, Shen Tong shook his head and said to Shen Yue with sincerity: "Yue'er, you have excellent cultivation talent, but you have never practiced hard. If you are a strong Martial King, like Huangfu Yan If the dandy dares to have evil intentions towards you, then the Iron Guards will dare to come and arrest you? Even if you are a Martial Emperor or a powerful Martial Lord, it is not me, Tianying Castle, who is in panic now, but his Medicine Emperor Palace!"
After taking a sip of ginseng tea, Shen Tong continued: "Zhong'er, Yue'er! You must remember that this world is a world of force, a world of strong men, and those with big fists have the final say!".
Clenching her fists tightly, Shen Yue gratefully whispered to Shen Tong: "Thank you, aunt, Yue'er knows!".
Shen Tai who was on the side also interjected: "Yue'er, your aunt is right. Remember to practice hard and strive to break through to the fifth level warrior as soon as possible, to release your vitality and pass the assessment of Tianyuan Mansion. With the identity protection of Tianyuan Mansion student, the Medicine Emperor Palace will not dare to take your idea."
After a pause, Shen Tai looked at Ye Zhong, and then said in a deep voice with a guilty look on his face: "It's just Zhong'er...".
Hearing this, Shen Tong interrupted Shen Tai and said in a deep voice: "My son, Shen Tong, can't be touched by anyone if he wants to! And the grudge between the Yaohuang Palace and my Tianying Castle cannot be resolved. This time it's just a new grudge plus old hatred! Others are afraid of his Yaohuang Palace, but I, Shen Tong, are not afraid!"
Shen Tai rubbed his hands and said with a dry smile: "Sister, that's not what I meant!".
Then he turned his head and whispered to Ye Zhong with a happy face: "There will be a distinguished guest coming tomorrow, Zhong'er, be prepared, don't make any mistakes and offend the distinguished guest! This is a good opportunity for you, Zhong'er, so you must cherish it."
However, Shen Yue asked softly in surprise: "Dignified guest? Who is it!".
After patting Shen Yue on the head, Shen Tai laughed and scolded: "You damn girl, I still think you haven't caused enough trouble! It's none of your business, so don't pry around, we'll know tomorrow!".
Waving his hands, Shen Hao smiled and said to Ye Zhong and Shen Yue: "Zhong'er, Yue'er, you all go back and have a rest! Put your heart in your stomach. Although the Yaohuang Palace is an unshakable behemoth to my Tianying Fort, my Tianying Fort is not a little grasshopper that can be bullied. If he wants to touch my Tianying Fort, the Yaohuang Palace will also have to weigh it."
Then he also told Ye Zhong: "Zhong'er, behave well tomorrow! Your mother and uncle and I still have something to discuss, so you can go to your room and rest first!".
"Okay, Grandpa!"
"Yes, Grandpa!"
Looking at Ye Zhong and Shen Yue leaving, Shen Hao had serious eyes and said in a deep voice with a heavy face: "Tong'er, Tai'er! This matter in the Medicine Emperor's Palace is probably a conspiracy of the City Lord's Mansion. He, Yin Kexi, has definitely set up a trap to kill someone with a borrowed knife!".
Nodding, Shen Tong said coldly: "It depends on the knife he borrowed from Yin Kexi. He was not quick. Others did not kill him, but hurt himself. If it were not for the fear of the county governor's house, his Yin family would have become history long ago!"
Glancing at his sister in surprise, Shen Tai then said in a deep voice: "Fifteen years ago, my brother-in-law helped Yaowang Valley and made the twenty-year agreement, but he hated Yaowang Palace. This time, I'm afraid Yaowang Palace will use this incident to deal with me, Tianying Castle!"
After a pause, Shen Tai then said with a look of hope on his face: "I guess Yaowang Valley has already received the news about this matter. And Yaowang Valley's strength is not much weaker than that of Yaowang Palace. Especially in Tianlong County, if Yaowang Valley misses the old friendship and protects Tianying Fort and Zhong'er to the death, then we don't have to worry so much!"
Shen Hao shook his head, but said worriedly: "Tai'er, you are too optimistic. That Yao Xi is a cultivation genius that is rare in a hundred years, and is regarded by Yao Wang Valley as the hope for his rise! He is also pretty and has a reputation far and wide. I heard that there are countless rich and powerful men who come to ask for marriage!"
Glancing at Shen Tong, who had a cold expression on his face, Shen Hao continued: "Zhong'er has not yet formed a 'Yuan Lun' and become a 'warrior'. I'm afraid that a proud daughter like Yao Xi may not look down on Zhong'er. And Yao Wang Gu is probably not willing to ask Zhong'er, a loser who is not even a warrior, to be his good son-in-law in Yao Wang Valley."
title_en: Chapter 7: Old and New Enmities Chapter 8: Distinguished Guests Come to the Door
